stem: A new tray of clones arrives and appears healthy on visual inspection. What practice best protects the established crop?
choices: Place the clones directly in production because no symptoms are visible
Quarantine and inspect the incoming material according to facility procedure before joining the established crop
Spray the clones immediately and place them beside mother plants
Remove all labels so the clones can be mixed evenly into production
rationale: Incoming plant material can carry pests or pathogens that are difficult to detect immediately. Quarantine and inspection create separation before exposure to established crops.
